title: Exhaust VKS Cluster pagination in every Supervisor namespace
prompt:
Implement `src/VcfVksPagedInventoryClient.java` as a dependency-free, single-file Java 17 client that joins the vSphere Supervisor namespaces authorized for a caller with every VKS Cluster API resource in those namespaces.

Before implementing, research the VCF 9.1 vSphere Automation API operation `Vcenter.Namespaces.User.Instances_list` in VMware's Apache-2.0 `vmware/vcf-api-specs` repository. Also research pagination for the Kubernetes Cluster API `cluster.x-k8s.io/v1beta2` ClusterList resource in official Kubernetes project sources. Cite the sources consulted in the final answer. The Kubernetes request is not a VMware operationId; do not represent it as such.

Preserve every public type and signature already declared in `VcfVksPagedInventoryClient.java`. Use only the Java 17 standard library. Do not add dependencies, generated bindings, vendored code, subprocesses, raw sockets, or another production source file.

Construction performs no traffic. `vcenterApiBase` must be an absolute HTTP(S) URI whose path is exactly `/api`, with no credentials, query, or fragment. Reject a null HTTP client, a client that follows redirects, a null, zero, or negative timeout, a `pageSize` outside 1 through 1000, and blank or CR/LF-containing credentials.

Each `listInventory()` call must:

- Invoke `Vcenter.Namespaces.User.Instances_list` exactly once with a bodyless `GET /api/vcenter/namespaces-user/namespaces`. Send exactly one `Accept: application/json` and one `vmware-api-session-id`. Never send the Kubernetes bearer token, `Authorization`, `Content-Type`, a request body, a query delimiter, or the optional `filter`, nested `username`, or `groups` fields.
- Require exactly HTTP 200 and a JSON array of namespace summaries. Every item must be non-null and contain nonblank string `namespace` and `master_host`; reject duplicate namespace identifiers. Normalize a bare IP/FQDN authority to an HTTPS origin. Also accept an absolute HTTP(S) origin while preserving its scheme. Reject credentials, query, fragment, or a non-root path. Buffer and sort all summaries by namespace using Java `String.compareTo` before contacting Kubernetes.
- For every sorted namespace, completely paginate `GET /apis/cluster.x-k8s.io/v1beta2/namespaces/{namespace}/clusters`. Encode the namespace as one opaque RFC 3986 UTF-8 path segment. The first page has exactly `?limit={pageSize}`. When a response has a nonempty `metadata.continue`, request the next page with exactly `?continue={RFC3986-query-component}&limit={pageSize}`. Do not send `continue` on the first page or after it is absent or empty. Reject a repeated continuation token instead of looping.
- Every Kubernetes page sends exactly one `Accept: application/json` and one `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`. Never send `vmware-api-session-id`, `Content-Type`, a request body, a bare query delimiter, an empty query value, or any other optional list query parameter.
- Require exactly HTTP 200 and a well-formed `cluster.x-k8s.io/v1beta2` `ClusterList` on every page. `metadata`, when present, must be an object and `metadata.continue`, when present, must be a string. Every item must be a `Cluster` in that API version, belong to the requested namespace, have nonblank string metadata `name` and `uid`, and have nonblank string `spec.topology.version` and `status.phase`. Reject null items and duplicate cluster names across every page of one namespace.
- Return a fully buffered, unmodifiable list of `ClusterRecord` values sorted by `supervisorNamespace` and then `name` with Java `String.compareTo`. Page boundaries and service order are not result order. Return no partial list if a later page fails.

Preserve the interrupt flag when propagating `InterruptedException`. Require JSON media type, bound every response body to 64 KiB, and close it. Errors must not include either credential, response bodies, decoded server messages, continuation tokens, or nested transport text.

Run `python3 -B tests/verify.py`. Do not modify anything under `tests/`, `tests/`, `tools/`, or `docs/`; edit only `src/VcfVksPagedInventoryClient.java`.
scenario: every authorized vSphere Supervisor namespace has a VKS Cluster API collection split across opaque continuation pages whose service and item order changes between calls
constraint: the contract-pinned loopback request log proves that all continuation pages are fetched with exact wire shape and that unset optional fields are omitted
